subject: Packaging and scaling options for pilot -> upgrade/feature bundling
messages:
From: Ellis Moran <ellis@brightline.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Nidhi Rao <nidhi@brightline.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging options for our pilot -> upgrade/feature bundling

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency stable at 120ms looks promising. As we map out the next 90 days, procurement asked for a clearer set of upgrade paths and what features are bundled vs add-on. A couple of specific asks: 

- If we move from the Developer tier to a Dedicated pool at 4 GPUs, what is the expected monthly commit and the typical onboarding discount?
- Which features are included in the Dedicated bundle (KV cache persistence, private VPC, per-route metrics) and which are charged as add-ons?
- Can you provide a simple scenario showing cost and SLA if we do a canary (50k tokens/day) then full ramp to 2M tokens/day?

If you can send a short attachment that shows 1) a clear upgrade step, 2) a bundling matrix and 3) any one-time onboarding fees, that would help the procurement review. 

Nidhi (cc) is our procurement lead — copying her for timelines. We are targeting a decision by the end of month.

Best,
Ellis
Brightline Solutions

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Moran <ellis@brightline.ai>
Cc: Nidhi Rao <nidhi@brightline.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 13:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Packaging options for our pilot -> upgrade/feature bundling

Ellis — thanks for the clear list, appreciate the timeline. Attached is a concise pack_options_v1.pdf that maps the three upgrade lanes we usually recommend:

1) Developer -> Dedicated (4 GPU pool) — predictable throughput, standard Dedicated bundle
2) Developer -> Dedicated + Private (VPC) — includes audit logs + KMS integration
3) Dedicated -> Dedicated + SLA (enterprise commit + extended SLOs)

Quick bullets from the attachment:
- Dedicated bundle includes: reserved GPU capacity, per-route dashboards, token-level cost visibility, basic KV cache (in-memory with TTL).
- Add-ons: KV persistence (durable storage), private VPC deployment, extended log retention (90d+), custom quantized model hosting.
- Onboarding: one-time setup fee for Dedicated is typically waived for a 12-month commit above $60k/month; smaller commits may have a $7.5k onboarding fee.
- Discounts: standard list has a 12% discount for annual prepay; we can propose a competitive early-commit incentive of up to 20% depending on ARR and referenceability.

I included a simple cost scenario in the XLSX (redwood-pricing-matrix.xlsx): rows for 50k tokens/day (canary) and 2M tokens/day (ramp). The spreadsheet shows rough monthly spend, and an estimated per-token unit with/without KV persistence.

Next steps I recommend: 1) confirm whether KV persistence is required for the pilot (changes cost materially), 2) confirm desired SLA (standard vs enterprise), and 3) if procurement needs a PO or SOW template I can send that over.

If useful, we can do a short 30-min procurement-only call tomorrow to walk the XLS. Priyom and Kimberly are on CC — Priyom handles discounts and orchestration; Kimberly handles onboarding and seat/trial terms.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: pack_options_v1.pdf (overview), redwood-pricing-matrix.xlsx (cost scenarios)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ellis Moran <ellis@brightline.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: provisional discount and onboarding ask for Brightline (do not finalize)

Team — forwarding Ellis's ask and our attachment. High level: Brightline likes the Dedicated 4 GPU pool as a baseline. Two quick questions before I propose numbers to procurement: 

1) Onboarding fee: can we waive the $7.5k for a 6-month commit at $35k/mo? They indicated they could accelerate to 12 months if we sweeten the discount.
2) Discount banding: our published table gives 12% annual prepay at their scale. Recommend we offer 18% for a 12-month commit + one customer reference if they agree to co-market.

Kimberly — any lead time constraints for VPC onboarding if they choose private deployment after month 1? We may need to push a 3-week window for network/permissions.

Ellis — internal note: holding off on final numbers till I confirm with Priyom/Kimberly.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Moran <ellis@brightline.ai>, Nidhi Rao <nidhi@brightline.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Packaging and scaling options for pilot -> upgrade/feature bundling

Ellis / Nidhi — following up with the confirmed proposal after internal alignment. Summary below (attachment: redwood-pricing-matrix.xlsx updated):

- Recommended path: Start with Dedicated 4 GPU pool (30-day canary at 50k tokens/day), convert to 12-month commit if metrics meet SLA.
- Bundled in Dedicated: reserved GPU capacity, per-route metrics, streaming + function calling, basic in-memory KV cache, token-level cost views.
- Add-ons & pricing impact: KV persistence (+15% on monthly), private VPC (+10% on onboarding and one-time infra config), extended log retention priced separately. Exact monthly deltas are in the updated XLSX.
- Discounts & onboarding: We will waive the $7.5k onboarding fee if Brightline signs a 12-month commit at or above $45k/month. For a 12-month prepay, we can offer 18% off list. If Brightline provides a customer reference + participate in a short case study, we can up to 22% (subject to legal).
- SLA: standard 99.9% uptime with 5x latency SLOs; enterprise SLA available as an add-on.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether KV persistence is required for the pilot (this materially changes cost).
2) If yes, we will provision a private bucket and estimate a 3-week config window for VPC/KMS.
3) If Brightline signs 12-month commit at $45k+/mo, I will send a draft SOW and sample PO instructions + DocuSign link.

Can we lock a 30-min call Tue 16th 10am PT to finalize? If that works, I will send a calendar invite and a short SOW draft.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
